answer: Tenure-weighted attestation: a vote counts only if the voter's ember has stayed lit 16 straight epochs, and weight scales with the square of that streak, so a fresh clone votes near zero. One missed epoch resets the ember to ash. Each identity also publishes its attestation vine, the Jaccard overlap of its first ten partners; two vine fingerprints matching above 0.8 trigger joint slashing that buries the cohort under one dune and forfeits every accrued streak. Fielding k credible votes needs k distinct partner sets plus 96 hours of per-head work, so attacker cost grows super-linearly in k.
